depthPolicy.reason: User-directed mandatory carrier shadows; preserves brand geometry, identity and underlying data. Numerical choices are proposals, not claims from original brandkit.

focus.rule: Keep a separate visible keyboard outline; never shadow-only focus.

exceptions.reason: Preserve exact data geometry; enclosing chart carrier owns shadow.
Preserve original scale and position; enclosing chart carrier owns shadow.
Keep glyphs and labels unshadowed for clear reading.
Preserve original logo/photo/icon pixels; containing composition owns shadow.
One responsible outer silhouette; no redundant shadow stack.
Accessibility: system border replaces shadow only while forced colors is active.

formats.Website: one carrier for each independent composition; control shadows remain visible
formats.App: same roles; preserve data and state meaning
formats.Slide: one nonzero shadow on responsible panel or scene; no text/data mark shadows
formats.PDF: retain carrier shadow in print; native export requires separate actual proof
formats.Design: shadow outer graphic carrier, preserve source imagery
formats.Edit: shadow functional overlay carrier, preserve people/logos/subtitles

stateNotes.header-navigation-group: Joined main navigation tabs share one header carrier; independent theme/menu/motion controls keep their own nonzero control shadow.
stateNotes.sidebar: Main cards/groups have one shadow; nested child links remain flat.
stateNotes.semanticCarriers: HAHA reuse-routing, rule panels and application gallery cards receive one responsible outer surface shadow; descendants share that carrier.
